## Summary

- Retries the `cargo package --allow-dirty --no-verify -p <name>` call in `scripts/check-crate-size.rs` up to three attempts before reporting the existing final package-size guard error.
- Keeps the archive lookup and size classification behavior unchanged after packaging succeeds.
- Adds unit coverage for success after a transient package failure and failure after all retry attempts are exhausted.
- Adds a patch changelog fragment.

## Reproduction

Before the fix, a fake `cargo package` that failed once with a transient registry-style error and would succeed on a second call caused the guard to exit immediately:
